news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 4 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 4 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. MD & Executive Director Munish Chawla is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2023. The company’s lack of experienced directors is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: First half 2026 earnings released: ₹1.74 loss per share (vs ₹185 loss in 1H 2025)
news.body: First half 2026 results: ₹1.74 loss per share (improved from ₹185 loss in 1H 2025). Revenue: ₹380.9m (up 95% from 1H 2025). Net loss: ₹17.4m (loss narrowed 81% from 1H 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 108% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 4% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
